finding: Tabari's third, separately headed reported identification names a group of Quraysh. The printed section contains three distinct report units: an Ikrima report recounting a Quraysh conversation about Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf; a separate Ikrima report about Quraysh saying Muhammad was cut off; and an Ikrima-from-Ibn-Abbas report recounting Ka'b's arrival and the Quraysh comparison. Preserve the speakers and routes as printed. Tabari's own preference beginning at displayed line 40 is outside this report group.

displayed_lines.34: Separate heading: others say the referent is a group of Quraysh.
displayed_lines.35: Report-section heading: 'Mention of those who said that.'
displayed_lines.36: Ibn al-Muthanna → Abd al-Wahhab → Dawud → Ikrima; recounts a Quraysh conversation in Mecca involving Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf and a comparison about the Prophet.
displayed_lines.37: Continuation of the first report: it connects the Quraysh speakers' words to the verse under review.
displayed_lines.38: Abu Kurayb → Waki → Badr ibn Uthman → Ikrima; a distinct report about Quraysh saying Muhammad was cut off and the one who accused him of being cut off being the one cut off.
displayed_lines.39: Ibn Bashshar → Ibn Abi Adi → Dawud ibn Abi Hind → Ikrima → Ibn Abbas; a distinct account of Ka'b's arrival in Mecca and the Quraysh comparison.
